title: Yellow Yeasty Malaysian dough Flatbread
description: A fermented Malaysian flatbread featuring salsa and low-carb friendly ingredients, with a bouncy and light texture.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast and warm water, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
Add coconut flour, eggs, salt, and garlic powder to the bowl, mixing until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired flatbread size.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Cook the flatbreads for 1-2 minutes on each side, until they are lightly browned and cooked through.
Serve the flatbreads warm with salsa spooned over the top.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately.
